messages.subject: Object counting double
parts:
Hello all, 

I was trying to count seedlings in a tray with fieldCount function, but as soon as the cotyledons are distinguishable the function counts double each plantlet.

With fieldObject function (https://github.com/OpenDroneMap/FIELDimageR#P11) putting watershed=F and adjusting the size threshold to your needs make the trick!

Enjoy!

And thanks for the nice tool Filipe & team!
